Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:167069
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 49998 of 2022

Applicant :- Kasim
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Shiv Ram Dubey,Amit Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Renu Sharma,Vivek Yadav
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Dhiraj Kumar Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Sri Vikash Chauhan, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Renu Sharma, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Jhamman Ram,
learned AGA for the State.

3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 209 of 2022, under Sections 376, 342, 506, 113 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act and 67B I.T.
Act, Police Station Chhawni, District Basti during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his wife on 05.07.2022 and according to the FIR applicant sexually exploited the victim when she was minor and also duped huge amount from her including her jewellery and also prepared her indecent video and photographs and send the same to her husband and due to the harassment and exploitation of the applicant informant i.e.
prosecutrix of the case tried to commit suicide.

Kasim vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43725846/

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant in the FIR appears to be vague and no reliance can be placed on such version and admittedly at the time of lodging the FIR, informant was major and married lady and on the basis of stale allegation of rape she lodged FIR of the present case.

He further submits that although victim made allegation of rape and sexual exploitation and sending of indecent photographs against the applicant in the FIR and in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C but when she appeared before the trial court and her statement was recorded before the trial court then she was declared hostile and categorically stated that applicant never committed rape with her and he never prepared her video and due to harassment of other persons she tried to commit suicide.
6. He next submits that applicant in the present matter is in jail since 04.08.2022 i.e. for more than a year, therefore, considering the statement of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial court, he may be enlarged on bail.
7.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that during trial prosecutrix i.e. informant of the case has declared hostile and applicant in the present matter is in jail for more than a year.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Although, in the FIR and in the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C.
and 164 Cr.P.C. there is allegation of rape and sexual exploitation against the applicant but from the FIR it appears that it was lodged after several months and at the time of lodging FIR, prosecutrix was major and married lady.

10. Further, from the statement of the prosecutrix recorded by the trial court, which has been annexed along with supplementary affidavit dated 07.08.2023, it appears that before the trial court prosecutrix i.e. informant of the case did not make any allegation against the applicant and categorically stated that neither applicant committed rape with her nor he ever prepared video and due to the harassment of some other persons she tried to commit suicide and lodged FIR against the applicant and thereafter she was declared hostile.
11.
Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 04.08.2022 i.e. for more than a year.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant - Kasim be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
